extraction_notes: The exact job identity is AO4407A from UMW Youtai Semiconductor Co Ltd. The PDF title is UMW AO4407A and the document imprint names UTD Semiconductor Co.,Limited.
P-channel quantities printed with negative signs are represented as positive magnitudes in the extracted specs and curve axes retain the negative-sign axis semantics.
Figures 1 through 8 contain usable electrical curves. Curve points are manual readings from visible plotted traces; no points were generated by interpolation.
The static characteristic figures are obtained using pulses shorter than 300 ms with maximum 0.5% duty cycle (datasheet Note E).

Electrical table values not represented by dedicated schema fields: IDSS is -1 uA maximum at VDS=-30 V, VGS=0 V and -5 uA maximum at TJ=55 degC; IGSS is +/-100 nA maximum at VDS=0 V, VGS=+/-25 V; gFS is 42 S typical at VDS=-5 V, ID=-14 A; maximum body-diode continuous current is -4 A.

Gate-charge table values: Qg(-10V) is 40 nC typical and 60 nC maximum; Qg(-4.5V) is 20 nC typical and 30 nC maximum; Qgs is 6 nC typical and Qgd is 10 nC typical. The shared table conditions are VGS=-10 V and VDS=-15 V, with ID=-14 A for Qgs and Qgd; Figure 7 is annotated VDS=-15 V and ID=-14 A.

Switching table values: tD(on)=11 ns typical, tr=10 ns typical at VGS=-10 V and VDS=-15 V, tD(off)=40 ns typical with RL=1.05 ohm and RGEN=3 ohm, tf=18 ns typical, trr=14 ns typical and Qrr=25 nC typical at IF=-14 A and dI/dt=500 A/us.

Thermal table values: RthetaJA is 31 K/W typical and 40 K/W maximum for t less than or equal to 10 s, 59 K/W typical and 75 K/W maximum steady-state; RthetaJL is 16 K/W typical and 24 K/W maximum steady-state.

Absolute maximum ratings include VDS=-30 V, VGS=±25 V, ID=-14 A at TA=25 degC, ID=-11 A at TA=70 degC, IDM=-56 A, IAS=-33 A, EAS=54 mJ at L=0.1 mH, PD=3.1 W at TA=25 degC and 2.0 W at TA=70 degC, and TJ/TSTG=-55 to 150 degC.
